verdict.rationale: Open WebUI documents its own webhook feature, which sends outbound notifications to external services, including 'any other application that supports incoming webhooks'. That goes beyond chat-app-only integrations, and a personal webhook fires when a chat response is ready. The only evidenced event is 'response ready'; there is no general event-subscription model, and payload details are not documented. missing for 10: a documented catalog of subscribable event types, payload schema and delivery/retry/signing details, programmatic webhook registration, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: A personal webhook that notifies individual users when a response to their chat is ready, especially useful for long-running tasks.
These webhooks allow you to receive automated notifications in external services like Discord, Slack or any other application that supports incoming webhooks
